contentList.content: Ka'vir hurls a rock at a far-off target for [1], ringing their skull. On a failed Constitution Saving Throw they are Stunned.

A washout who never earned a silver sword, swinging a silver club to spite the creche that threw him out. Ka'vir's momentum climbs with every hit he lands, raising his damage and speed and eventually leaving his targets <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunned</LSTag>. When a wild swing meets nothing but air, he cracks his own skull and the momentum slips a step.
